description: MERGE insert/update matrices over VALUES sources and staging tables, converted 1:1 from dml/MergeOperationsTest.java (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, price INTEGER)
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Widget', 100)
MERGE INTO products USING (VALUES (2, 'Gadget', 200)) ON id = 2 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES (2, 'Gadget', 200)
SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, price INTEGER)
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Widget', 100), (2, 'Gadget', 200)
MERGE INTO products USING (VALUES (1, 'Widget', 150)) ON id = 1 WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET price = 150
SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = 1
